verdict.rationale: WorkOS is a hosted, multi-tenant SaaS auth platform; there is no evidence of a self-managed/on-prem deployment option, private single-tenant instance, or ability to run the auth system against a customer-owned database. WorkOS Vault (BYOK) only lets customers bring their own KMS keys for encrypting secrets stored inside WorkOS, not relocate the auth system or user data itself, and community commentary explicitly notes customer login data lives in WorkOS's own database with lock-in concerns (workos-comm-8), reinforcing the lack of deployment control.
